journeys.goal: I need to correct my local image generator connection and return to the same unfinished image request.

start.surface: Suite Manager > Applications > Plan an Image
start.action: Start New Image, enter a prompt, then choose Generator Setup.

new_user.default_route: Use Connect or install, choose an existing SwarmUI or a managed installation, then Return to Generation Plan.
new_user.ease_check: One setup task is visible at a time and Return stays available when switching tasks.
new_user.overload_guard: Runtime controls, model paths/import, backups and updates are in their own named tasks rather than a single action wall.

advanced_user.entry: Choose Run and status, Models and import, or Maintenance directly; Setup search reveals the relevant task.
advanced_user.customization: Review model paths, configuration backups, the companion package or updates without hiding the connection choice.
advanced_user.continuity: Switching tasks does not change the generator, discard the saved request, or dismiss Return.

consistency.reference: Original all-in-one Setup > Local Generation (the same SwarmRuntimeWidget)
shared_patterns: A visible task list selects one pane.
The contextual return stays outside the selected task.
departures: Connection and runtime status stay above the task list because they apply to every task; generator actions retain their existing separate review dialogs.

steps.action: Start a new image, enter a prompt, let the draft save and choose Generator Setup.
steps.expected: Manager opens the shared four-task setup surface and retains the same draft.

steps.action: Switch to Maintenance and back to Connect or install.
steps.expected: Only the selected task's actions appear; Return to Generation Plan stays visible.
The same prompt and request return without probing or launching a generator.

completion.visible: Generate shows the same request and saved prompt after Return.
completion.authority: Setup navigation changes no runtime, installation, model file, or generation result; connection and import actions keep their separate explicit reviews.

recovery.trigger: SwarmUI is not enrolled or a later setup action is unavailable.
recovery.expected: Connect or install names the next setup choice, while Return remains available so the saved request is not stranded.

automation.notes: Source-component host integration with generated profiles and fake runtime I/O; installed package and actual SwarmUI lifecycle are not claimed.

journeys.goal: See the last known local-generator state and open the right generation or setup workflow.

steps.action: Open Dashboard with no saved local generator.
steps.expected: Set Up Generation is available; Dashboard performs no runtime probe.

steps.action: Choose Set Up Generation, inspect the four existing task sections and Close.

steps.action: Choose the ready or busy card action.
steps.expected: The existing image draft chooser or generation-work entry receives the request.
